request: Add to Calamaio a command count-kills, titled "Count Kills", that shows in the echo area how many kills the kill ring holds, as "Kills: 2", on the key C-c k (ctrl+c k). Write it in Lisp, as a defcommand and a defkey in the program's killring.lisp.

add./program/killring.lisp/count-kills:
(defcommand count-kills "Shows how many kills the ring holds." :title "Count Kills" :category "Killing"
  []
  (message (str "Kills: " (count state.kills))))
